Question 9
?

Find fxy(x,y)+fyx(x,y) given that fx(x,y)=xcos⁡(x2−y2) and fy(x,y)=−ycos⁡(x2−y2).

a
4xysin⁡(x2−y2)
b
2(x2y+xy2)sin⁡(x2−y2)
c
2(x2+y2)sin⁡(x2−y2)
d
−2xysin⁡(x2−y2)
e
4x2y2sin⁡(x2−y2)
